text_block_list.text:
Бива Хаяхидэ loses at the Kikuka Sho,
but she
looks proud and satisfied to
have put everything
on the line to win.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
After the race, Нарита Таисин and
Уиннинг Тикит
stop by to exchange
compliments and
encouragement.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The next race is the spring Tenno Sho.
There,
we'll have our rematch with
Нарита Таисин.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Бива Хаяхидэ vows to win it with a
smile that is
much, much brighter than it
has been recently.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
